candidates.issues: Very natural translation. Title is slightly long but descriptive and idiomatic. 'בחום של 170-180' is a great way to handle the missing 'degrees' from the source. '0.25 כפיות' would be better as 'רבע כפית', but it matches the source formatting.
Incorrect pluralization ('1 טיפות'). 'סוכר גרגירי' is less idiomatic than 'סוכר לבן'. The word 'לגריפה' in the title sounds awkward and industrial rather than culinary.
Retaining the slash in 'שמנת עשירה/שמנת מתוקה' is too literal; 'שמנת מתוקה' alone is the standard culinary equivalent in Israel. Title and instructions are good.
Incorrect pluralization ('1 טיפות'). Includes a slash in the cream translation, though 'שמנת מתוקה להקצפה' without the slash would have been perfect. Title adaptation is nice and creative.
